description.value: An obligate association of a tube-forming precipitator and at least two filament lineages that cannot be reared apart, catalogued as one organism since 2281. Towers stand two to four metres over a vent seam and fall when the flow moves, which happens on a scale of decades. Every tower recovered from a plumbed seam leans at an angle no unattended tower has been observed to take.
